messages:
sasha: found parity bug between REST and python-sdk for async embeddings. curl -> 202 + Location; python-sdk treats 202 as error and retries, creating duplicate jobs. repro below.

sasha: curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{\"model\":\"embed-lite\",\"input\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}'
# -> 202 Accepted
# -> Location: /v1/jobs/ab12cd
```

sasha: python-sdk:
```
job = client.embeddings.create_async(model=\"embed-lite\", input=[\"a\",\"b\"])
# raises HTTPError(\"unexpected status: 202\") and our retry loop re-sends
```

kevin: that matches support tickets. probable root cause: code that only accepts 200. i'll patch to accept any 2xx and to parse Location header for job id.

kevin: patch sketch:
``
- if resp.status_code != 200:
-     raise HTTPError(...)
+ if resp.status_code < 200 or resp.status_code >= 300:
+     raise HTTPError(...)
+ job_loc = resp.headers.get('Location')
+ if job_loc:
+     return Job.from_id(job_loc.split('/')[-1])
```

maria: add an integration test that mocks a 202 + Location and asserts no retry and job id returned. ensure parity across node and go sdks.

liam: customer got billed for duplicates so flag as high priority/hotfix.

devex-bot: Created issue #3456: \"python-sdk: accept 2xx for async endpoints and parse Location header to avoid duplicate async jobs\" assigned to kevin, priority: high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3456

sasha: follow-up: add a tiny e2e step in the onboarding sample app CI that calls an async endpoint so this doesn't regress. low effort, high ROI.

kevin: will open PR with test + changelog and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
